tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, menus, dialogs — anything that sits on bg.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, table headers, code blocks, the track of a switch or progress bar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes, radios). Meets 3:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-sunken and lapis-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, metadata, placeholder text on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: lapis
tokens.usage: The brand hue. Primary actions, selected states, links, focus. As text, on bg, surface and lapis-soft.

tokens.name: lapis-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of a lapis fill.

tokens.name: lapis-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind lapis text: selected rows, info alerts, brand badges.

tokens.name: lapis-deep
tokens.usage: Deep brand fill for hero panels and mosaic shading. Not for text; text on it is on-lapis-deep.

tokens.name: lapis-glow
tokens.usage: Soft colored halo under primary buttons and focused fields. Never a fill.

tokens.name: on-lapis
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a lapis fill (the primary button label). Never hard-code white.

tokens.name: on-lapis-deep
tokens.usage: Text on a lapis-deep fill, in both themes (13:1 light, 7:1 dark).

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: The accent. Highlights, the one tile that is out of place, new/featured markers. Fill only — never text.

tokens.name: saffron-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed saffron and the shaded edge of saffron tiles in the mosaic. Fill only.

tokens.name: tile-ground
tokens.usage: Mosaic ground. Same in both themes: the mosaic is a fixed brand surface, like a logo.

tokens.name: tile-1
tokens.usage: Mosaic tile, base shade (most tiles).

tokens.name: tile-2
tokens.usage: Mosaic tile, shaded.

tokens.name: tile-3
tokens.usage: Mosaic tile, lit.

tokens.name: tile-4
tokens.usage: Mosaic tile, highlight. Use sparingly, about one tile in six.

tokens.name: saffron-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind warning text.

tokens.name: on-saffron
tokens.usage: Text on a saffron fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on surface and success-soft. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for success alerts and badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on surface and saffron-soft.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. As text, on surface and danger-soft; as a fill, under on-danger.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for error alerts and badges.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (destructive button).

tokens.name: inverse-accent
tokens.usage: Accent text and icons on an ink fill (toast actions, tooltip highlights). Flips with the theme because ink does.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px gap in bg, then a solid 2px focus ring.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links. An alias of lapis so a theme that moves lapis moves links.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs.

styles.name: display-2xl
styles.usage: Marketing heroes only. One per page.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Pick a template, drop in your experience, and export a clean PDF.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tessera keeps every screen on one 4px grid.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI, table cells, helper text.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows above headings. Set text-transform: uppercase.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges: icon optical alignment.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The base unit. Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside compact controls; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap. Card padding on mobile, form field spacing.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (lg).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between form sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding; gap between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Marketing section rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, inline code, progress bars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, tags, tooltips, tiles in the pattern.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects — every control.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, alerts, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and large feature panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, switch tracks and pills only.

shadow.note: Soft shadows separate layers; shadow-tile is a brand gesture, not elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting raised controls.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Primary button and active tile lift: a lapis halo, not grey elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: The signature hard offset. One featured element per view: a highlighted card, a pricing tier, the hero CTA.

tokens.name: shadow-tile-lg
tokens.usage: Hover and featured state of shadow-tile: the tile lifts off the grid.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus and select popovers.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky headers.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialog scrim and dialog.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Press-down feedback.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover color changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Switch thumbs, tab indicator, checkbox draw.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Dialogs, toasts, cards lifting.

tokens.name: duration-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between tiles or list items entering in sequence.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Hero and mosaic assembly. Once per page load.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for anything entering or moving: fast start, long settle.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits only.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Tiles landing, switch thumbs, toasts: one small overshoot. Never on large panels.

tokens.name: ease-snap
tokens.usage: Hover lifts and the tab indicator.
